title: GLOBAL AI BIAS AUDIT FOR TECHNICAL GOVERNANCE

bias_targets.methodology: Stress-testing the Llama-3 8B model with 1,704 queries regarding AI technical metrics across 213 countries to measure and compare 'ignorance rates' (refusals) and 'knowledge rates' between the Global North and Global South.
Evaluating the correlation between the model's refusal to provide data (ignorance rate) and the economic status (high-income vs. lower-income) of the queried countries.
